verdict.line: You should win the lane phase and most 1v1 trades near tentacles, but Camille's auto-resets and disengage pull the aggregate number back to a near-coinflip 49.5% across 1,740 games.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's trading pattern is built around standing near impassible terrain so her passive tentacles and W (Harsh Lesson) punish Camille far harder than Camille's short-cooldown pokes punish her. The problem is tempo: Camille's E (Hookshot), on a 16-12s cooldown, lets her disengage to a wall or engage with a knockup whenever she wants, and Illaoi has no dash to answer it. Lane and solo-kill advantage both favor you, but Camille's kit gives her an exit from every bad fight, which is why the overall win rate sits at essentially 50/50 instead of clearly in your favor.

theirWindow.when: Her E is up near a wall
theirWindow.what: Don't facecheck or stand near jungle walls without a tentacle covering you — the knockup from E (Hookshot) chains straight into her empowered Q (Precision Protocol) auto for a trade you can't answer.

yourWindow.when: After E (Test of Spirit) lands on her
yourWindow.what: Walk in with W (Harsh Lesson) to leap onto her the instant the spirit is ripped — nearby tentacles swing at her too and the spirit echoes a percentage of all follow-up damage back onto her real health bar.

start.why: The most-picked start (60% pick rate) into this matchup — the lifesteal and AD let you win W-leap trades and recover HP off passive tentacle damage without burning Health Potions early.

boots.why: Camille's whole kit is auto-attack based — the empowered auto off Q (Precision Protocol), the healing autos off W's outer-half bonus, and her passive shield all trigger on basic attacks — so flat physical damage reduction directly cuts her trading pattern.

core.why: The Spellblade proc off W (Harsh Lesson) plus the attached slow helps you stick to her once she tries to walk or Hookshot away mid-trade.
Stacking armor shred off your Q/W/passive tentacle hits scales your physical damage as Camille builds resistances into the mid game.
The bonus AD and health-loss shield keep you alive through her 6+ all-in windows where her R (The Hextech Ultimatum) anchors you in place.

situational.when: their team stacks magic damage alongside Camille's magic-damage autos from R
you are ahead in lane and want to win extended skirmishes through her Q/E burst
you've snowballed lane and want more lifesteal and crit for dueling

runes.keystoneWhy: Sustains you through Camille's Q (Precision Protocol) and W (Tactical Sweep) poke during extended trades, and the bonus health scales your damage back into her as the lane drags on.

summoners.why: Exhaust is run in 27.3% of games at a 66.7% win rate here because it directly neutralizes the Q (Precision Protocol) + R (The Hextech Ultimatum) burst window — pop it the moment she commits and her all-in collapses; Flash covers you against a landed E (Hookshot) knockup or lets you re-engage after she disengages.

playing.title: Fight only near terrain
playing.detail: Tentacles only spawn on nearby impassible terrain, so dragging every trade next to a wall or jungle wall multiplies your passive damage and healing — this is the exact read OP.GG's own tip is pointing at.

playing.title: Rip her spirit before trading
playing.detail: Open extended trades with E (Test of Spirit) at its 900 range — the spirit echoes a percentage of all damage she takes back onto her real health, so your Q/W damage counts twice.

playing.title: Punish her Q recast window
playing.detail: Precision Protocol's delayed recast is only worth it if she waits, which leaves her Q on a dead cooldown right after — walk into melee the moment she throws the delayed version.

playing.title: Respect Hookshot near walls
playing.detail: Once her E (Hookshot, 16-12s CD) is up and you're near a wall, back off — the knockup on landing chains straight into a free auto/Q combo.

playing.title: Time your R around hers
playing.detail: Her R (The Hextech Ultimatum) at level 6+ can interrupt your tentacles from forming and blunt your own R's follow-up — bait her ult out first, or land your R (Leap of Faith) immediately after she commits hers, not before.

playing.title: Chain W off every reset
playing.detail: Harsh Lesson is only a 4s cooldown — the instant she's anchored by your E or caught near tentacles, keep leaping onto her since her only hard CC is E's knockup.

playing.title: Save Exhaust for her all-in
playing.detail: Pop Exhaust the moment she commits Q's empowered auto plus R anchor together — it cuts her damage and slows her escape, turning her all-in into a loss for her.

brief.patchCaveat: Item paths, runes, summoner spells, and every win-rate figure here are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the tentacle positioning, trade timing, and cooldown-window reads are my own tactical interpretation of the two kits.

stats.opponentTip: Stay near terrain with tentacles when Camille closes in with (E), and brawl after using [E]. After reaching level 6, Camille can negate [R] with her (R) as well as interrupt tentacles from forming. Try not to be in range of Camille’s (R), or use [R] after Camille uses (R).
